To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the two stereophotography software packages tested in this study performed well in the reconstruction of the 3D shape of a virtual sample with a rough and therefore high-contrast surface.

3D nanometrology based on SEM stereophotogrammetric reconstruction is a viable method for the reconstruction of 3D models of samples with rough surfaces, and that the method needs further improvement for samples with low-contrast zones.

the stereophotogrammetric reconstruction of a 3D surface from two SEM images taken at two perpendicular perspectives is feasible and that it can be used to measure the surface topography of rough surfaces with a measurement uncertainty of ≈1.2 nm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of 3D SEM metrology.
the development and validation of a new 3D metrology method based on SEM stereophotogrammetric images.
3D reconstruction of a sample from SEM images taken at two different perspectives.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the present 3D reconstruction software packages are suitable for SEM stereophotogrammetric reconstruction of samples with a rough surface, but they need further improvement before their use is reliable for samples containing uniform zones.
stereophotogrammetric SEM 3D reconstruction of real samples is possible, but only if they have a rough surface and are not too small.
stereophotogrammetric reconstruction of SEM images is possible, but the software packages currently available are not suitable for all types of samples.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the present stereophotographic SEM image analysis software packages are suitable for SEM images of samples with rough surfaces, but not for samples with nearly uniform zones.
the 3D reconstruction of a surface based on SEM images can be performed reliably with a rough sample surface and that a uniform sample surface needs further improvement.
3D SEM stereophotogrammetric reconstruction is possible, but the software packages are not ready for routine SEM 3D metrology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
simulated SEM images can provide valuable information for the validation of SEM stereophotogrammetric algorithms.
the simulated SEM images are a useful tool for testing, developing, and validating stereophotogrammetric algorithms.
stereophotogrammetric reconstruction is a promising approach to 3D nanometrology.
